taxonomy.note: Stable species-level canonical entry; accepted local infraspecific concept S. drummondii var. texanum is taught internally.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays Natural Purola flora records Symphyotrichum drummondii; Travis herbarium and Williamson county treatment document accepted var. texanum. Current Kew accepts S. drummondii var. texanum.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Exact county evidence only; infraspecific records counted only after current-taxonomy reconciliation.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the two-tier leaf pattern: larger lower leaves taper into winged petiole-like bases, while upper branch leaves become much smaller and narrower. Stems and new growth are short-hairy; heads carry pale lavender to whitish rays.
diagnostic_traits: lower leaves relatively large and serrate
lower blades taper into winged petiole-like bases
upper leaves much smaller and narrow
